mapper.update: UPDATE system_organization_node SET node_code = CASE WHEN id = #{nodeId} THEN #{nodeCode} ELSE node_code END, node_name = CASE WHEN id = #{nodeId} THEN #{nodeName} ELSE node_name END, sort_order = CASE WHEN id = #{nodeId} THEN #{sortOrder} ELSE sort_order END, description = CASE WHEN id = #{nodeId} THEN #{description} ELSE description END, full_path = CONCAT( #{newFullPath}, SUBSTRING(full_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldFullPath}) + 1) ), updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE path_ids LIKE CONCAT(#{pathIds}, '%')
